sbx run <<'EOF'
pip install z3-solver >/dev/null 2>&1
cat > /workspace/solve_z3.py <<'PY'
from z3 import *
import time
pairs=[]
for line in open('/workspace/pairs.txt'):
    a,b=line.split()
    pairs.append((int(a),int(b)))

def rotl8(x,n):
    return (x << n) | LShR(x, 8-n)

def g(a,b,c):
    # c is constant 0/1
    temp = a + b + BitVecVal(c,8)
    return rotl8(temp,2)

def F(v):
    x=[Extract(8*i+7,8*i,v) for i in range(4)]  # x0 LSB
    y=[None]*4
    y[2]=g(x[3]^x[2], x[1]^x[0], 1)
    y[3]=g(x[3], y[2], 0)
    y[1]=g(x[1]^x[0], y[2], 0)
    y[0]=g(x[0], y[1], 1)
    return Concat(y[3],y[2],y[1],y[0])  # y0 LSB

def expand(k):
    return k ^ (k << 16) ^ (k * BitVecVal(12345,32))

def enc(pt, keys):
    left=Extract(63,32,pt); right=Extract(31,0,pt)
    right = right ^ left
    for i in range(4):
        mixed=F(right ^ keys[i])
        left,right = right, left ^ mixed
    left = left ^ right
    return Concat(right,left)

ks=[BitVec(f'k{i}',20) for i in range(4)]
keys=[expand(k) for k in ks]
s=Solver()
for pt,ct in pairs:
    s.add(enc(BitVecVal(pt,64),keys)==BitVecVal(ct,64))
s.set('timeout', 600000)
t=time.time()
print(s.check())
print('time',time.time()-t)
if s.check()==sat:
    m=s.model()
    print([hex(m.eval(k).as_long()) for k in ks])
PY
python3 /workspace/solve_z3.py
EOF

import subprocess
keys=['68e63','62571','1f61c','b74a5']
ok=True
for line in open('/workspace/pairs.txt'):
    p,c=line.split()
    out=subprocess.check_output(['/workspace/feal',hex(int(p))[2:],*keys],text=True)
    got=int(out.split('Ciphertext:')[1].strip(),16)
    if got!=int(c):
        ok=False; print('mismatch',p,c,got); break
print('all pairs verified:',ok)
PY
